description: This file is a Perl script that processes configuration files, particularly those with lines starting with a specific prefix 'CONFIG_'. It includes functions for loading, manipulating, and comparing configuration data, as well as parsing expressions that combine configurations. The script appears to be part of a build or configuration system, likely related to kernel or software build configuration management.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sets a configuration value in the provided hash based on certain conditions.

methods.name: load_config
methods.description: Loads a configuration file and returns a hash of configuration settings.

methods.name: config_and
methods.description: Computes the intersection of two configuration hashes.

methods.name: config_add
methods.description: Merges two configuration hashes, with special handling if mod_plus is true.

methods.name: config_diff
methods.description: Finds differences between two configuration hashes.

methods.name: config_sub
methods.description: Subtracts one configuration hash from another.

methods.name: parse_expr
methods.description: Parses and evaluates configuration expression strings.
